name: Old Murkfin
place: dungeon flooded_cistern set A: floor 2 mini-boss (24 m settling tank)
_doc: Stream E (M2). A blind bottom-feeder grown fat in the settling tank. It hunts by SOUND: its Silt Cloud blinds the room and it charges whoever it hears — the charge breaks the rotten pump housings (cover). Every so often it stirs the silt into a whirlpool that pulls everyone in (run out). At 60% the tank drains and it flops about, calling silt crawlers; kill them to make it dive back (shield drops). Hard enrage 5 min.
party: Solo: whirlpool + charge are dodgeable; the crawler phase is long alone. 2-3: ideal. 5: crawlers die fast; M5 should add crawlers per player (+1 each) and ~x1.5 health.

pull: Something enormous stirs in the silt. Two milky eyes the size of plates turn toward the noise you made.
Old Murkfin rises out of the mud, whiskers twitching.
say.death: Old Murkfin sinks back into the silt, and this time it does not come up.
say.reset: The silt settles. Somewhere under it, Old Murkfin waits for a sound.

enrage.say: Old Murkfin goes into a blind thrashing frenzy!

silt_charge.name: Blind Charge
silt_charge.say: Old Murkfin hears {target} — it charges! Don't stand in front of a pump unless you want it gone.

whirlpool.name: Silt Whirlpool
whirlpool.say: The silt starts to swirl — swim OUT of the whirlpool!

phases.name: Stranded
phases.say: The tank drains! Old Murkfin flops in the mud and calls its brood!
phases.shieldDown: The last crawler dies — Old Murkfin dives back into the deep silt, wide open!

phases.name: Deep Silt
phases.say: It is angry now, and it can hear EVERYTHING.
